answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent docks once at the harbor of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. A vault record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once, and only sustained work reaches the summit of trusted standing.
